text.p: Italian bonds and Btp futures closed down but above session lows in the wake of a fall in T-bonds on strong U.S. manufacturing data, but traders said the session had been quiet with prices already lower in a correction to the rally of recent days.

The market started lower pausing for breath after this week's sharp rally, but dealers said the outlook was still positive with operators looking forward to an expected fall in Italian April CPI and a likely Bank of Italy interest rate cut.
The June Liffe Btp contract ended 49 basis points off at 128.53 but was off its earlier session low of 128.26.
